CreateStarterMappingTemplate.note: `outputSampleLocation` is written through the caller's session (forward-access), so the S3 write grant rides along.

GenerateMapping.note: GenerateMapping invokes Amazon Bedrock through the caller's session (verified live: "Access denied when invoking Bedrock's InvokeModel API" without the grant). The account must also have Bedrock model access enabled for the mapping model in the region.

StartTransformerJob.note: B2BI reads `inputFile` and writes `outputLocation` through the caller's session (verified live: "Access denied when getting object attributes from s3://…" without these). The buckets are request-time values, so the grant cannot be resource-scoped here.

TestConversion.note: `target.outputSampleFile` is read through the caller's session (forward-access), so the S3 read grants ride along.

TestParsing.note: B2BI reads `inputFile` through the caller's session (verified live: "Access denied when getting object attributes from s3://…" without the S3 grants), so the documented companion permissions are granted alongside.
